# Teleparty - Watch Together on Netflix, YouTube, HBO Max + more

## About Teleparty
Teleparty (formerly Netflix Party) is a browser extension and web service that allows friends to watch TV shows and movies together online. Users can synchronize video playback, chat in real-time, and share reactions while watching content on popular streaming platforms.

## Supported Platforms
- Netflix
- YouTube
- Disney+
- Hulu
- HBO Max
- Amazon Prime Video
- Crunchyroll
- And many more streaming services

## Key Features
- Synchronized video playback across all participants
- Real-time chat during watching sessions
- Voice and video chat capabilities
- Mobile support for iOS and Android
- Premium features for enhanced experience

## How It Works
1. Install the Teleparty browser extension
2. Start watching on any supported streaming platform
3. Share the party link with friends
4. Everyone's video syncs automatically
5. Chat and react together in real-time

## Use Cases
- Long-distance movie nights with friends
- Family gatherings across different locations
- Watch parties for new show releases
- Group reactions to favorite content
- Educational content viewing with classmates
- Corporate team building through shared entertainment

## Technical Information
- Browser extension for Chrome, Safari, Edge
- Web-based interface for party management
- Real-time synchronization technology
- Cross-platform compatibility
- No account required for basic features
- Premium subscription for advanced features

## Safety and Privacy
- No personal data collection
- End-to-end encryption for chat
- Privacy-focused design
- No tracking of viewing habits
- Secure party links

## Getting Started
Visit teleparty.com to download the extension and start your first watch party. The service is free to use with basic features, with premium options available for enhanced functionality.

## Support
- Help documentation available on website
- Community forums for user support
- Email support for technical issues
- FAQ section for common questions

## Legal
Teleparty respects copyright and does not host or stream any content. Users must have valid subscriptions to streaming services to use the platform.

homepage.body:
Teleparty

Watch together on Netflix, YouTube, HBO Max + more

  • Home
  • Premium
  • Support
  • Install

A New Way to Watch TV Together

Teleparty (formerly Netflix Party) is a new way to watch TV with your friends online. Teleparty synchronizes video playbook and adds group chat to Netflix, Disney Plus, Hulu, HBO Max, and Amazon Prime. Available on Chrome, Edge, and Safari browsers.

  • Get Teleparty for Free
  • Get Started

Supported Streaming Platforms

Host a Watch Party on Netflix, YouTube, Disney Plus, HBO Max, Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, and many more streaming services. Create Teleparties in seconds right on your favorite streaming sites to stream millions of great shows together with friends.

  • Netflix Watch Party
  • YouTube Watch Party
  • Disney Plus Watch Party
  • HBO Max Watch Party
  • Hulu Watch Party
  • Amazon Prime Watch Party

Synchronize with Your Friends

Always stay precisely in sync when you're watching TV shows together. Enjoy HD video quality and fast buffering in all of your Teleparties on both desktop and mobile. Sync Teleparties in HD for the ultimate viewing experience.

Customize Your Teleparty

Make it yours! Customize your Teleparty by choosing a fun user icon and nickname. Choose from a large array of themed icons and make the experience yours. Synchronized video playbook, group chat, emoji reactions, and premium features for the ultimate watch party experience.

  • Learn about Premium Features

How Teleparty Works - Step by Step

1. Install Teleparty: Click the 'Install Teleparty' button and add it to your Chrome, Edge, or Safari browser. 2. Pin Teleparty: After installing, you should see the 'Tp' button next to your address bar. 3. Open a Video: Go to a streaming site like Netflix and choose any show you would like to watch. 4. Create a Teleparty: Click on the red 'Tp' icon and then 'Start Party' to get started. 5. Join a Teleparty: Share the party URL with friends so they can join and watch together.

  • Install Teleparty

Teleparty

Watch TV together with your friends online. Available for Chrome, Edge, and Safari browsers.

Join our Discord Community
